name: build2pitch-monorepo
description: BUILD2PITCH - One-day entrepreneurship event platform for student teams

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build

author: BUILD2PITCH Team
